title: yadgar/project-db
$comment: Closure is per chart (ADR-0850): this file closes only project-db's own key set, at root and in every block it declares; it bounds no other chart. OPEN (untyped {} maps, any shape passes): `global`, the one key the parent forwards into every module; `resources` and `database.instance.resources`, handed to `toYaml` for the pod's and the engine's own resource shape; `rollingUpdate`, handed to `with` for the Deployment's own strategy shape. EXTRAS (a template reads these, `values.yaml` does not declare them, so they are listed as leaves inside their closed block rather than left open): `image.digest`, read by `templates/deployment.yaml` and rewritten with the released digest by ci-release at package time (D65); `networkPolicy.scrapeFrom.namespace`, read by `templates/networkpolicy.yaml` (`values.yaml` ships `scrapeFrom: {}`, so without this extra the whole block would stay an open map). TYPES, TOGGLES AND `required` ARE A RENDER CHECK'S JOB (ADR-0847), not this file's: `templates/render-checks.yaml` already refuses a non-bool `autoscaling.enabled`, a non-bool `database.create` and a non-map `autoscaling`, by name, and this schema adds nothing on top of those checks. The one exception is `database.migrationLockTimeoutSeconds` (ledger 814, ADR-0837): it keeps its `type: integer, minimum 1, maximum 590`, and `database` keeps `type: object` and `required: [migrationLockTimeoutSeconds]` — both shipped before ledger 990 and unrelated to it. NO `required` is added for `tls.enabled` here: that lands in C-DB1 (ADR-0845, ADR-0857/K-8), never in this unit.

migrationLockTimeoutSeconds.description: Seconds a replica waits for another one's migration before failing its boot. Rendered as DB_MIGRATION_LOCK_TIMEOUT_SECONDS and read with no fallback. Minimum 1: GET_LOCK with 0 never waits and with a negative wait never takes the lock. Maximum 590: see chart/values.yaml.
